The US recently cautioned the island nation of Madagascar to be wary of its relationship with Russia, as similar partnerships across Africa have done little to improve security and may further destabilise the region.

The US’s warning is in reference to the relatively new partnerships Sahelian countries, particularly Burkina Faso, Niger and Mali, have formed with Russia.
